wake_days.description: idle stretch, in days of observed time, after which a move counts as a wake

safes.description: Safes that are the admin of a tracked contract (holder, or the Safe behind a bare-contract holder)

read.description: of those, how many answered nonce() this run

woke.description: <chain>:<shortened Safe address> labels of the Safes whose nonce moved after wake_days or more unchanged

changes.description: every Safe whose nonce moved since the previous run: safe, delta (transactions executed), idle_days (observed idle time before the move), woke, regressed (the nonce went down: the Safe was replaced), governs (the <chain>:<contract> keys), previous_run

never_executed.description: <chain>:<shortened Safe address> labels of the Safes still at nonce 0: an admin path that has never been used

by_safe.description: <chain>:<hash of the Safe address> -> safe (the <chain>:<shortened address> label), nonce, observed_since, idle_since (first run that read this nonce), last_moved, never_executed, governs, stale / stale_since when the Safe did not answer this run
